_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/s16a-memory-is-data.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-20 (unattended run 6).

features.description: update_memory requires confirmation in the tool definition, so sync_builtin_tools writes the gate onto its Flow Tool row and a migrate restores it.
A chat run whose model calls update_memory pauses and executes nothing until the exact answer Approve.
The approval question shows the exact note text, who will be able to read it, and whether it adds or replaces.
Control and format characters in the note are shown escaped in the question, so a note cannot write a second question or reorder the one being asked.
A tool call asking for agent scope is refused with a not_executed result and writes nothing.
A tool call passing the memory_id of an agent-scope row is refused with a not_executed result and changes nothing.
A user-scope write still works end to end and is stamped with the session user, not the model's claim.
An unattended run (a trigger, or auto_approve) writes no memory, is refused with a not_executed result, and does not pause.
save_memory still writes agent scope for a caller that asks for it explicitly, so the desk path is unchanged.
A thumbs-down comment creates a user-scope memory stamped with the person who gave it, never a shared one.
The memory block appears in no system-role message of the prompt.
The memory block is delivered inside the last user message, fenced, after that message's own text.
A memory whose text is an instruction reaches no system message and causes no tool call.
Memory content cannot forge or close the fence: the markers and control characters inside a memory are shown escaped.
A turn that carries memory stores exactly the messages the run produced: none twice, none dropped.
ephemeral_prompt_prefix still returns the same count with memory present as without it, on both transcript shapes.
Existing memories keep being read: nothing is deleted, migrated or rewritten by this change.
_invoke, _resolve_confirmation, _confirmation_question and _has_denial are byte-identical to their reviewed form, and upstream's TestAgentConfirmation is unmodified and green.
No text this change puts in front of the model or a person names the platform, a vendor or a model.
